display.purpose: Welcome hero and large brand moments only. Frank Ruhl Libre serif — never on a button, label, or data cell.

headline.purpose: Section headers on welcome / empty surfaces. Serif.

title.purpose: Panel and card headers, catalog item names. Heebo sans.

body.purpose: Running text and descriptions, capped at 65–75ch. Heebo sans.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, chips, table numbers. Heebo sans.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, a catalog card lifting on hover/focus, an item dragged onto the canvas. Cast in the ink hue, never a cool blue.

motion.name: ease-fluid
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions; ~150ms. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one saturated control on a screen; the single most important action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { direction: rtl; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: oklch(0.44 0.12 24); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.38 0.12 24); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default for toolbar and secondary actions; no fill or border at rest, lifts to Oxblood Wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { direction: rtl; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.40 0.014 25); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.022 24); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: The destructive affordance. Muted and quiet at rest; on hover the background lifts to Warn Wash and the label to Warn Amber — never a red button sitting loud on the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { direction: rtl; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0.03 68); color: oklch(0.55 0.13 68); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only ghost control (close, back, undo). Always carries an aria-label; lifts to Oxblood Wash on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="סגור" title="סגור"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); padding: 4px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.022 24); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Canvas-white field with a leading muted icon; border darkens on hover, shifts to Oxblood on focus.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: block; direction: rtl; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { direction: rtl; width: 100%; height: 36px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding-inline-start: 32px; padding-inline-end: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.006 25); border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.40 0.014 25); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: oklch(0.44 0.12 24); }

components.name: Tag Toggle
components.description: Toggleable style-tag chip. Active state carries fill AND border, never color alone; aria-pressed carries state to AT.
components.css: .ds-tag { direction: rtl; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.40 0.014 25); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.006 25); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: oklch(0.40 0.014 25); } .ds-tag--on { background: oklch(0.95 0.022 24); color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); border-color: oklch(0.44 0.12 24); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.12 24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Catalog Card
components.description: Catalog item; the product image is the hero, chrome is minimal, flat at rest and lifting a Floating shadow on hover/focus. A hairline footer divides off the tabular price.
components.css: .ds-card { direction: rtl; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: right; background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.006 25); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; width: 180px; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0.22 0.012 25 / 0.10); outline: none; } .ds-card__img { aspect-ratio: 4/3; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.006 25); background: oklch(0.982 0.004 25); } .ds-card__name { margin: 0; color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card__meta { margin: 2px 0 0; color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card__foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.006 25); } .ds-card__price { color: oklch(0.22 0.012 25); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card__edit { color: oklch(0.52 0.014 25); font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__edit, .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card__edit { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: An atelier at first light: a chromaless paper surface, one deep oxblood for the marks the designer makes, and all the real color coming from the objects laid out on it — the hall plan and the product photography — never from the surface itself. The luxury is carried by an editorial Hebrew serif and generous space, not by the body background; a product photo of a gold tablecloth reads as gold, not as 'gold, next to a colored button competing for attention.' Restraint here is not the same as unfinished. The system commits to a chromaless canvas, a single oxblood accent, a serif-and-sans pairing, and flat tonal depth — and then spends its care on the details that make a professional trust a tool: aligned tabular counts, legible RTL Hebrew, hairline dividers, states that respond without shouting.
keyCharacteristics: Chromaless neutral canvas; the accent and the designer's imagery are the only color.
One accent (oxblood, hue 24), used on ≤10% of any screen.
A serif display (Frank Ruhl Libre) for headings and welcome surfaces, Heebo sans for all UI and body.
Flat by default; depth is tonal, shadows only on things that truly float.
Every operational output survives black-and-white printing.

rules.name: The Neutral Canvas Rule
rules.body: The workspace is chromaless. The only saturated color on any screen is the accent (≤10% of the surface) and the designer's own product imagery. If the chrome competes with a product photo for attention, the chrome is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: 'Luxury' is never expressed by a warm-tinted body background — that is the AI cliché. The canvas stays true white; warmth lives only in the oxblood accent and the serif type.

rules.name: The Print Rule
rules.body: Every operational output (placement map, packing list) must survive black-and-white printing. Distinctions carry through weight, shape, and label — never color alone.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Display-Only Rule
rules.body: The serif appears on headings, the welcome page, and spacious empty states — never on a button, form label, table cell, or any dense tool UI. In the studio and catalog chrome, Heebo sans rules.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every quantity and dimension (packing-list counts, mm measurements, quote line totals) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align down the page and in print.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state — hover, drag, focus, or opening. A resting card with a drop shadow is a bug.

dos: Do keep the workspace chromaless — accent on ≤10% of any screen, everything else ink on white (The Neutral Canvas Rule).
Do set headings, the welcome page, and empty states in the serif; keep every button, label, and data cell in Heebo sans (The Serif-For-Display-Only Rule).
Do design RTL-first; Hebrew is the primary direction, mirrored layouts are the default, not a retrofit.
Do use tabular-nums on every count, dimension, and price (The Tabular Count Rule).
Do keep every operational output legible in black-and-white — carry meaning in weight, shape, and label (The Print Rule).
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative (a crossfade or an instant state change).
Do pair the warn amber with an icon and words; color is never the only signal.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no purple gradients, no hero-metric cards, no chart-everything layouts, no endless icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't reach for a trendy dark-mode developer terminal — wrong world for event and interior design.
Don't go consumer-flashy or playful: no bright bounce, gamification, or illustration filler.
Don't become a cluttered enterprise CRM: no dense gray-on-gray toolbars or deep nav trees burying the canvas.
Don't use a colored side-stripe border (border-left/border-right > 1px) on cards, list items, or alerts — use full hairline borders or a background wash.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — emphasis comes from weight and size, in one solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism as decoration — flat and tonal, or nothing.
Don't set body or placeholder text in light gray 'for elegance'; muted is 0.52 and no lighter, and body runs on ink.

Don't express luxury with a cream/sand/beige body background, or with gold gradients and serif-everything — the gold-and-cream 'luxury events' look is the cliché this system refuses (The No-Cream Rule).
